data.name: Harooni
data.long_meaning: Harooni is an Arabic name derived from Harun, meaning 'high exalted one'. It is also associated with Aaron, the brother of Prophet Musa (Moses) in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaron, the brother of Prophet Musa, was known for his wisdom and faith. The name Harooni carries a similar spiritual significance, symbolizing wisdom, faith, and leadership.
data.numerology_meaning: A master builder, a visionary, and a humanitarian. They have a strong intuition and the ability to sense the needs of others. They are capable of heights of creativity, but they must learn to focus and center themselves in order to make their vision a reality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Harooni reflects the high social status and legacy of Aaron in Islamic and Jewish traditions. It is a name deeply rooted in the Middle Eastern culture, particularly among Arab communities. In the context of Arab culture, it is a common name for boys that evokes feelings of nobility, harmony, and exaltedness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Harooni holds a significant spiritual meaning as it is derived from the name of Aaron, who was a close companion and confidant to Prophet Moses. Aaron was a pious and righteous man who played an essential role in the delivery of the Ten Commandments to the Israelites. In Islam, Aaron is considered an exalted figure, and the name Harooni is a reminder of his ongoing spiritual influence. The name embodies the ideals of humility, knowledge, and faithfulness, as well as a powerful connection to the sacred roots of monotheistic traditions.
